Maël, a scion of a royal family of cambria was sent in his ninth year to the abbey of yverne so that he might there study both sacred and profane learning at the age of fourteen he renounced his patrimony and took a vow to serve the lord his time was divided according to the rule between the singing of hymns the study of grammar and the meditation of eternal truths

Male, a scion of a royal family of Cambria, was sent in his ninth year to the abbey of Yvern, so that he might there study both sacred and profane learning. At the age of fourteen he renounced his patrimony, and took a vow to serve the Lord. His time was divided, according to the rule, between the singing of hymns, the study of grammar, and the meditation of eternal truths.
